Name: Casino Predictor
Author: jane20524
Description:
[size=5][b]Casino Predictor[/b][/size]

Tired of losing all your Qi Coins? [b]Casino Predictor[/b] reads the casino's luck before you do.
It doesn't guess or estimate odds — it follows the game's own random number generator, so the prediction matches what will actually happen.

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]

[b]Calico Spin (slot machine)[/b]
[list]
[*]Shows whether the [b]next spin[/b] will be a [color=#2e8b57]WIN[/color] (with its multiplier) or a [color=#c0392b]MISS[/color].[/*]
[*]While the reels are spinning, shows the result of the current spin.[/*]
[*]Got a MISS? Leave the machine and sit back down — the result is re-rolled every time you open the machine.[/*]
[/list]
[b]CalicoJack[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Dealer's total[/b], including the hidden card.[/*]
[*][b]Next card[/b] you'll get if you Hit.[/*]
[*]What happens if you [b]Stand now[/b] — the dealer's final total and whether you win.[/*]
[*][b]Best play[/b]: how many times to Hit before you Stand to win (or at least get a Standoff).[/*]
[*][b]Next game prediction[/b] on the results screen: the next game's starting cards and whether you can win it — so you know whether to press [b]Double Or Nothing[/b], start a [b]New Game[/b], or [b]Quit[/b].[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Controls & settings[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]F9[/b] — show/hide the prediction during a casino game (configurable).[/*]
[*]With [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] installed, you can change everything in-game:
[list]
[*]Turn Calico Spin / CalicoJack predictions on or off separately[/*]
[*]Text size (0.8x – 2.0x)[/*]
[*]Show/hide key[/*]
[*]Log prediction accuracy to the SMAPI console[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*]Without GMCM, edit [i]config.json[/i] in the mod folder (created after the first launch).[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*](Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].[/*]
[*]Unzip this mod into your [i]Mods[/i] folder.[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 / SMAPI 4.0+ (tested on 1.6.15 with SMAPI 4.5.2).[/*]
[*]Windows tested. Linux/macOS should work but haven't been tested.[/*]
[*]Multiplayer and split-screen haven't been tested yet.[/*]
[*]Doesn't edit any game files or save data — safe to add or remove at any time.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Languages[/b][/size]
English, 한국어 (Korean), 中文 (Simplified Chinese), 日本語 (Japanese).
The game terms (Hit, Stand, Double Or Nothing, etc.) match each language's official in-game text.
Translations are welcome — just send me an [i]i18n[/i] file!

[size=4][b]FAQ[/b][/size]
[b]Q. Is it always right?[/b]
A. It uses the exact same random sequence and logic as the game, so it should be. If you ever see a mismatch, turn on accuracy logging and send me the SMAPI log ([url=https://smapi.io/log]smapi.io/log[/url]).

[b]Q. The next spin is a MISS. If I wait, will it change?[/b]
A. No — the game is paused while the slot machine is open. Close the machine and sit back down to re-roll.

[b]Q. Does it work at the high-stakes CalicoJack table?[/b]
A. Yes. Both tables use the same rules.

[size=4][b]Bug reports[/b][/size]
Please post in the Bugs tab with your SMAPI log ([url=https://smapi.io/log]smapi.io/log[/url]).
